title: Model recipe
description: A miniature 3D model as a list of simple parts, designed by Gemini (server/gemini/model_designer.py) and built live in three.js by the eye page (web/eye/models/builder.js). Units: the model stands on the ground at y = 0, about 1 unit tall; x is left-right, z front-back, both centred on 0. Also used verbatim as Gemini's response schema, so it sticks to the subset Gemini accepts (no $ref, no oneOf).

name.description: Short name of what was built, e.g. 'moss-covered watchtower'.

animation.description: Whole-model idle motion. Creatures breathe or bob; buildings none or sway.

size.description: Width, height, depth (x, y, z), each 0.02 to 1.2. For cylinder/cone/sphere/dome/capsule width is the diameter.

pos.description: Centre of the part's base: x and z in -0.8..0.8, y (height of the part's bottom) in 0..1.4.

rot.description: Rotation in degrees about x, y, z (-180..180), about the part's own centre. Optional.

repeat.description: Optional: copies of this part. ring = evenly round the y axis at radius; line = along x with spacing.

anim.description: Optional motion of this part alone: flicker for flames, flap for wings, spin for windmills.
